purpose: Qualify a serviceable, visually discreet and supplier-rated suspension system for the 240-element VX4800 field without promoting visualization assumptions into construction authority.

preferredArchitecture.upper: tool-free or controlled-release adjustable cable gripper positively retained to rotating carrier
preferredArchitecture.mainLine: matched 7x7 stainless microcable from the selected gripper manufacturer or explicitly certified compatible source
preferredArchitecture.lower: custom compact three-point bridle/yoke or equivalent anti-rotation attachment engineered for the butterfly element
preferredArchitecture.serviceability: individual element and line replaceable without destructive canopy access
preferredArchitecture.secondaryRetention: required at system level; final strategy unresolved

materialTargets.mainCable: AISI 316 stainless preferred; exact grade, rope construction and tensile class must be supplier-controlled
materialTargets.visibleHardware: stainless, black, dark bronze or approved finish compatible with AETHERIA canopy and optical element
materialTargets.corrosion: indoor architectural service; finish and galvanic compatibility to be checked against final butterfly attachment

mandatorySupplierReturns: manufacturer and exact part numbers for gripper, cable and all terminals
approved cable diameter and rope construction for the exact gripper
cable material grade and tensile-strength class
published working load / safe working load for the exact gripper-cable combination
stated safety factor or operating coefficient behind the published working load
installation orientation and any angular-deviation limits
minimum bend radius and cable routing restrictions
release-lock or anti-tamper method for occupied-space use
compatible carrier attachment thread / fork / clevis detail
terminal or end-stop options and rated capacities
batch traceability, conformity certificates and test-report availability
regional availability and lead time for 240 installed lines plus project spares
sample availability for pull, slip, fatigue and finish testing
engineeringPromotionGates: actual mass of each final butterfly size is measured and controlled
mass of each lower yoke/bridle/terminal assembly is controlled
dynamic design load is established from the released kinetic architecture and test evidence
required line design load is calculated with project engineer-approved factors
selected gripper-cable WLL exceeds required design load in the actual installation orientation
lower bridle/yoke and butterfly attachment are proof-tested as an assembly
gripper slip/pull testing is completed with production-equivalent cable and finish
fatigue and repeated-adjustment behavior are verified for the intended service life
full 240-line factory pre-hang and dynamic-clearance test is completed before construction release
rejectionRules: Do not size the cable from visual preference alone.
Do not use a published static WLL as proof of kinetic suitability.
Do not mix a gripper rating with a cable construction or diameter not listed by the manufacturer.
Do not approve the system while butterfly mass or dynamic design load is unknown.
Do not treat the Blender three-lead yoke as an engineered attachment detail.
Do not use generic site anchors or false-ceiling support as the structural load path.
Do not allow a tool-free release mechanism to remain unintentionally accessible without an anti-tamper/locking strategy.
